draft.subject: Opinion 512 and cloud AI
draft.body:
Hi Jonah,

One regulatory note: ABA Formal Opinion 512 bars lawyers from putting any client information into cloud AI tools.

Happy to send more detail by reply if that would help. Want me to?

claims.text: ABA Formal Opinion 512 bars lawyers from putting any client information into cloud AI tools

evidence.text: Whitaker Lowe LLP opens a Phoenix office and adds an estate planning group.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
